comments: Input facts: ego is the car responder; agent1 is the car initiator; the actors interact on crossing roadways after a prior lateral evasive action. Chosen assumptions: agent1 approaches a four-way intersection on a lateral incoming lane, performs an evasive lane change left, and then enters a straight crossing trajectory. Agent1 stops upon entering the crossing connector after completing the evasion; ego continues its straight trajectory, providing an obstruction conflict opportunity. The evasive action is a chosen prior circumstance; no third actor or prior collision is assumed. Speeds are in m/s, distances in m, preparation is 2 s. Lane changes use the normal controller; the programs allow a conflict opportunity without requiring a collision.
